prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / high-resolution background texture restoration. EDIT TARGET is this exact cropped fragment of the existing Opera house backing plate. Restore this fragment alone at the highest supported native resolution, maintaining EXACTLY the input aspect ratio, framing and every normalized edge/line/material boundary. Request native long edge 2048 or higher. It is one of 24 overlapping tiles that must be assembled back into the original room. Do not create a new composition or zoom out to show an entire room. Preserve every wall/ceiling/balcony-slab/floor/carpet curve at the same normalized coordinates, including partial features cut by the crop. The empty-looking areas are intentional behind separately preserved original fixture cards. Do not add doors, arches, columns, railings, lights, furniture, plants, trim, text, characters or decorations. No invented detail objects. Add only fine painted surface detail appropriate to the EXISTING materials: smooth muted coral plaster, ivory/gold moulding, finely grained terrazzo or woven carpet where already present. Keep the source's exact colors and gentle brightness: no red/orange shift, extra warmth, saturation, contrast, bloom, dramatic lighting or vignette. Preserve the crop boundaries exactly for stitching. Output one full-bleed restored tile; no frame, margins, labels, grid or alternatives.
Tile identifier r2_c0 is bookkeeping only: do not render it.
